_note: Blocks an ENTRY whose reward:risk to the nearest overhead resistance is below min_reward_risk: (resistance near edge - signal price) / (signal price - signal stop). Uses each strategy's own stop, unlike the flat-% resistance filter. Breakout strategies (breakout_trend, inside_bar_breakout, vcp_breakout, high_tight_flag) exclude it in their own configs - they buy THROUGH resistance. Added 2026-11-14, ships disabled: sweep it per strategy (scripts/tune_strategy.py) before enabling.
_engine: null = global default (config/sr_engine.json); 'legacy' or 'fractal' overrides it for this filter only.
_fail_mode: what to do when there is NO resistance zone above price: 'allow' (open upside) or 'block'.
